text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 30, 2024) for 21 Twenty Second Street

The Property Standards Committee - Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (July 30, 2024) for 21 Twenty Second Street, Folder Number 24 188054 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
